description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rebase --fork-point' command behavior in a Git repository. It sets up a repository state, defines test functions, and runs multiple test cases to validate different scenarios and options related to the rebase operation.

methods.name: do_test_rebase
methods.description: Performs a rebase operation, compares the result with expected output, and verifies the log output.

methods.name: test_rebase
methods.description: Wraps 'do_test_rebase' with a test expectation and description.
